description: Elections Commission - S. Balaachandra and H. P. D. S. Pathirana of the Seethawaka Pura Urban Council has Vacated his/her office of Members of the United National Party
categorisation: This gazette content contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Seethawakapura Urban Council due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including candidate registrations, office vacancies, and electoral commission decisions.
